title: CuLEmo: Cultural Lenses on Emotion - Benchmarking LLMs for Cross-Cultural Emotion Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLMs on culturally-specific emotion prediction and sentiment analysis tasks across six countries (USA, Mexico, Germany, UAE, Ethiopia, India) by comparing zero-shot text generation outputs against native-speaker annotations, both with and without explicit country context prompts.

Comparing emotion and sentiment prediction accuracy when prompting LLMs in English versus in-language prompts (Arabic, Amharic, German, Hindi, Spanish) to measure performance disparities across high-resource and low-resource languages.
